catalogReady.search: Search all products by name, SKU, barcode or manufacturer
catalogReady.searchBatch: Search all batches by product, barcode or lot
catalogReady.packageHint: Package description only; quantities count the stock unit below.
catalogReady.unitHint: Choose what one inventory unit means. No automatic pack conversion. The unit cannot change after stock movements exist.
catalogReady.onlineOnly: An online connection and current permissions are required for these changes.
catalogReady.openingDescription: Record inventory already held by this branch. Creates a batch and an opening ledger movement together. For supplier deliveries, use Purchasing and receiving.
catalogReady.openingInvalid: Choose a product and enter a lot, valid expiry date, positive quantity and selling price, optional nonnegative cost, and reason.
catalogReady.openingSaved: Opening stock posted to the inventory ledger.
catalogReady.dateHint: YYYY-MM-DD; expiry is required by the current batch model.
catalogReady.retryOpening: This request was saved before submission. Retry the same request to confirm its result without duplicating stock. Its values remain fixed until accepted.
catalogReady.identityOnly: Creating a batch identity adds no inventory. Use Opening stock to enter existing quantities, or Purchasing to receive a delivery.
catalogReady.repriceHint: Selling price changes apply to future sales. Historical purchase cost remains unchanged. Review the new price before confirming.
catalogReady.invalidOrder: Every order line needs a positive quantity and a valid nonnegative cost, if supplied.
catalogReady.receiptInvalid: Some receipt rows need correction. No receipt has been submitted.
catalogReady.adjustmentInvalid: Enter a positive quantity and a reason.
catalogReady.countInvalid: Every entered count must be a valid nonnegative quantity.

errors.unitLocked: The stock unit cannot change after inventory movements exist.
errors.batchMismatch: This lot already exists with different expiry, cost or selling price. Review its batch record before posting.
errors.priceChanged: The batch price changed since you selected it. Select the batch again and review the current price.
errors.retryMismatch: This request reference was already used with different values. Review the existing operation before continuing.
errors.invalidValues: Check the quantities, costs, prices and dates. Quantities allow up to four decimal places; prices and costs allow two.
